description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService class, which manages user authentication, registration, password management, and account enabling/disabling using ASP.NET Core Identity within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service implementing IUserService to handle user authentication, registration, password management, and account status using ASP.NET Core Identity within OrchardCore.

methods.name: AuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username or email and password, reporting errors via callback.

methods.name: CreateUserAsync
methods.description: Creates a new user account with optional password, logging the outcome.

methods.name: ChangeEmailAsync
methods.description: Changes the email address of a user, returning success status.

methods.name: ChangePasswordAsync
methods.description: Changes the password of a user, returning success status.

methods.name: GetAuthenticatedUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated user from a ClaimsPrincipal.

methods.name: GetForgotPasswordUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user for password reset purposes, generating a reset token.

methods.name: ResetPasswordAsync
methods.description: Resets a user's password using a reset token, reporting errors.

methods.name: CreatePrincipalAsync
methods.description: Creates a ClaimsPrincipal for a user.

methods.name: GetUserAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by username or email.

methods.name: GetUserByUniqueIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: ProcessValidationErrors
methods.description: Processes identity errors and reports user-friendly messages.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new user, invokes registration events, and signs in if not canceled.

methods.name: EnableAsync
methods.description: Enables a user account and triggers enabled event handlers.

methods.name: DisableAsync
methods.description: Disables a user account, ensuring at least one admin remains enabled, and triggers disabled event handlers.
